recommendations.text: Reword testing as "feature and unit tests per module, CI-gated" - the vocabulary 3/9 JDs used. Add Pest ONLY if actually used; never write it in otherwise.
Surface the AI-tooling experience higher: 2/9 JDs asked for AI-assisted development and one named Claude Code explicitly. The CV has trainer-level evidence - that is a differentiator, not a footnote.
Keep leading with Laravel+Vue and Laravel+React rather than Inertia. Inertia appeared in 0/9 JDs this run - real experience, but not what the market searches on.
English B1 -> B2 is the highest-return gap: it blocked 2 otherwise-qualifying postings this week at uncapped 83 and 80. Honest counter-argument: a CV edit cannot fix this.
